name: hcportal_authorizeRosterImport
description: The permission gate for the portal's 'Import from file' roster import (E2.F2.S6). The API endpoint api/Endpoints/RosterImport.cs calls it before it reads the uploaded file or spends anything on the AI mapping. Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth with @publicKennelId as callerParamString. Gate: the caller's HC.HasherKennelMap.AppAccessFlags on the kennel must include any of 0x40000081 (super admin / admin bits) — the same test hcportal_bulkAddHashers applies when the grid is saved afterwards. Read-only apart from logging a refusal to HC.ErrorLog. Returns one row in every case, with the same five columns.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Auth: portal device id, validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Auth: short-lived portal token; param string UPPER(deviceSecret):UPPER(publicKennelId).

parameters.name: publicKennelId
parameters.description: The kennel the import is for. Also the token's callerParamString. Unknown or NULL gives 'No kennel with that id.' (a NULL normally fails auth first).

rowsets.name: AuthorizeResult
rowsets.description: Exactly one row on every path (auth failure, unknown kennel, not authorised, success, CATCH). On refusal the three data columns are NULL.

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: NULL on success; otherwise the auth error, 'No kennel with that id.', 'You are not authorised to add members to this kennel.', or 'Please try again.' (CATCH)

columns.name: kennelId
columns.description: Lower-cased HC.Kennel.id as text; NULL on refusal

columns.name: kennelShortName
columns.description: HC.Kennel.KennelShortName (column is NVARCHAR(25)); NULL on refusal

columns.name: adminId
columns.description: Lower-cased HC.Hasher.id of the caller as text; NULL on refusal

sideEffects: On a permission refusal: INSERT HC.ErrorLog ('Not authorised', HcVersion '<portal>', with userId and kennelId)
On a runtime error: INSERT HC.ErrorLog ('Unhandled error in hcportal_authorizeRosterImport')

codeSmells.detail: Line 37 tests HasherKennelMap.AppAccessFlags & 0x40000081 instead of HC6.CheckKennelPermission, so a Mismanagement role that may manage members (the other independent grantor on HasherKennelMap) is not honoured. It deliberately mirrors hcportal_bulkAddHashers, so both must change together.
kennelId and adminId are returned as LOWER(CAST(... AS NVARCHAR(40))) (lines 44-45) rather than UNIQUEIDENTIFIER; harmless for the C# caller but inconsistent with other portal SPs.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
